originalTitle: Watch: What leaked audio reveals about Spain train crash
summary: Recordings between a control centre and the train drivers appear to show one train was given clearance to move even though another train had stalled on the track.
content:
Leaked audio recordings published by Spanish media have shed light on communications between a control centre and train drivers in the moments before two trains collided outside Toledo.

Officials are investigating the cause of the disaster, which occurred when a train from Madrid to Seville barrelled into a stationary train.

Southern Europe correspondent Sarah Rainsford explains what the audio reveals.
chineseTitle: 观看：泄露的音频揭示了西班牙火车事故的真相
chineseSummary: 控制中心和火车司机之间的录音似乎显示，尽管另一列火车已经停在轨道上，但一列火车仍获得了移动许可。
chineseContent:
西班牙媒体发布的泄露录音揭示了托莱多郊外两列火车相撞前一刻控制中心和火车司机之间的通信情况。

官员们正在调查这场灾难的原因，事故发生时，一列从马德里开往塞维利亚的火车与静止的火车相撞。

南欧记者莎拉·雷恩斯福德 (Sarah Rainsford) 解释了音频所揭示的内容。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
